query: What reasons or compliance risks appear in declined expenses?

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Describes what kind of asset the expense concerns, not a reason or compliance risk for the decline. It is an attribute of the expense that may correlate with declines, not an aspect OF the decline reason itself.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: Whether the entry was manual or auto-generated is a provenance attribute that could predict data-quality declines, but it is not itself a constituent aspect of the decline reason.

per_column.name: asset_lifecycle_action
per_column.rationale: Captures the lifecycle stage/action of the asset, an attribute of the expense context rather than a facet of why it was declined or what compliance risk applies.

per_column.name: source_id_present
per_column.rationale: A data-completeness flag on a source identifier. At best a predictor/symptom of a possible compliance/data issue, not a constitutive part of the decline-reason concept.

per_column.name: ci_id_quality
per_column.rationale: Quality classification of the CI identifier; a data-quality attribute that may drive declines but does not decompose the reason concept into its aspects.

per_column.name: travel_related
per_column.rationale: A flag on whether the expense is travel-related, an attribute of the expense subject matter, not an aspect of the decline reason or its compliance-risk dimensions.

judge.rationale: None of the added columns are constitutive facets (parts) of 'declined_expense_reasons'. A proper faceted decomposition would carve the decline-reason concept into aspects such as reason category (policy violation, missing documentation, budget/limit exceeded, duplicate, unauthorized category), severity, compliance-rule type, and remediation status. Instead, every column describes attributes of the expense or its data quality (asset type, provenance, lifecycle stage, ID completeness/quality, travel flag) which are at best external predictors or symptoms of declines, not aspects OF the decline reason. Because there are zero facets, MECE cannot be satisfied: both mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness score 0.
